title: Sources: Anthropic's revolving credit facility is set to surpass its ~$10B target as banks compete for roles on the upcoming IPO; Anthropic could limit the size (Bloomberg)
summary: Bloomberg: Sources: Anthropic's revolving credit facility is set to surpass its ~$10B target as banks compete for roles on the upcoming IPO; Anthropic could limit the size — Anthropic PBC's revolving credit facility is set to rise above its roughly $10 billion target, according to people familiar with the matter …
